sources.text: Boas-vindas ao Próxima Semana em XBOX! Neste post semanal, cobrimos todos os jogos que chegarão em breve ao XBOX Series X|S, XBOX One, XBOX no PC e XBOX Game Pass! Confira abaixo mais detalhes sobre esses próximos jogos e clique em seus perfis para mais informações (datas de lançamento sujeitas a alteração). Vamos começar! 1499. Paris é tomada pelas chamas quando criaturas monstruosas surgem repentinamente das sombras. Trevor Belmont, o herói que derrotou Drácula, aventura-se pelas ruas em chamas ao lado de sua filha, Rose Belmont. Armados com o lendário chicote sagrado Vampire Killer, eles caçam as feras que escapam do imponente castelo. Logo, Rose se vê envolvida na sombria conspiração que se esconde por trás de tudo. Será que ela conseguirá salvar Paris da devastação? 13 de outubro – Game Pass / XBOX Play Anywhere Deep Dish Dungeon é um jogo brasileiro de exploração de masmorras que recompensa a curiosidade e a capacidade de improvisar. Em um ambiente envolvente, explore corredores, salas e passagens por conta própria ou com até dois amigos e reúna recursos para melhorar seu acampamento. Crie ferramentas e prepare refeições nutritivas para fortalecer o grupo ao longo da jornada enquanto desvenda o enigma que se esconde nas sombras. Construa um mundo ainda mais selvagem em Planet Zoo 2 , sequência do adorado simulador de zoológicos. Dê asas à criatividade ao construir e administrar zoológicos únicos ao redor do mundo, repletos de animais impressionantes — incluindo, pela primeira vez, espécies totalmente aquáticas e voadoras. Além disso, avance na conservação animal e liberte suas espécies em vastas Reservas de Vida Selvagem personalizáveis. 13 de outubro – Game Pass / XBOX Play Anywhere Você serviu a Napoleão. Morreu por Napoleão. E ressurgiu por Napoleão. Você é William, um soldado da Grande Armée trazido de volta de uma sepultura no campo de batalha. Mas a Europa na qual você desperta não é aquela pela qual se sacrificou. Uma praga misteriosa agora assola o continente, e você renasceu com seu poder corruptor pulsando em suas veias. Cada morte é uma oportunidade de se tornar mais forte. Domine um sistema de combate com aparos, esquivas e finalizações brutais, usando uma variedade de armas. Canalize seu poder para aprimorar ataques e desbloquear novas habilidades sobrenaturais para usar contra seus inimigos. Embarque em uma jornada inesquecível pelo mundo encantador de Teradea, onde a vida Criado no sossego de Bloomfield Village, você está prestes a ver sua vida mudar para sempre. Uma névoa misteriosa avança da Floresta dos Ecos, feras selvagens vagam sob o manto da noite e estranhos desastres ameaçam vilarejos por toda a região. Explore uma paisagem vasta e dinâmica, repleta de cavernas escondidas, ilhas remotas, cidades cheias de vida e segredos há muito esquecidos. Guiado pela Deusa da Colheita e com a ajuda dos amigos que encontrará pelo caminho, você descobrirá novas maneiras de crescer, explorar e ajudar onde for necessário. Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2 é a sequência brutal e frenética do FPS retrô Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun. Dando continuidade direta aos acontecimentos do final do primeiro jogo, sua missão levará você a novos locais em uma campanha solo com caminhos ramificados, que combina de forma natural o universo sombrio de Warhammer 40,000 com a ação acelerada de um jogo de tiro em primeira pessoa. 15 de outubro – Game Pass / Entrega Inteligente / XBOX Play Anywhere Brinque, explore e registre momentos com Bluey e Bingo nesta aventura fotográfica por lugares conhecidos da série. Guarde lembranças por conta própria ou lado a lado com um segundo jogador, descubra a vida selvagem australiana e transforme momentos do jogo em diversão na vida real. Cada foto é salva no seu próprio álbum, onde você pode guardar seus melhores momentos. 15 de outubro – Game Pass / XBOX Play Anywhere Entre no Coliseu acorrentado aos seus amigos. Chained Beasts é um roguelike cooperativo de gladiadores para um a quatro jogadores, que combina combates brutais, trabalho em equipe e momentos divertidamente atrapalhados. Será que você consegue reunir seus amigos, esmagar os inimigos, conquistar o público e recuperar sua liberdade? Enquanto se recuperam de tempos incertos, seus Peeps se veem nas costas de Kewa, uma Baleia Espacial solitária que viaja pelo universo. Construir uma cidade nas costas de uma criatura senciente traz desafios próprios, mas, à medida que você fortalece esse vínculo e percorre a galáxia, surgem grandes oportunidades de exploração e expansão sustentável. Conheça outras espécies, atenda às necessidades e aos desejos dos seus Peeps e busque a verdade sobre os ancestrais deles e sobre as Baleias Espaciais. Celebre sucessos icônicos de diferentes gerações que ganham vida com coreografias únicas. Cada década conta com identidade visual própria e uma seleção de músicas cuidadosamente escolhida, permitindo que você viaje entre eras musicais ou crie a playlist definitiva, dos clássicos nostálgicos aos hits atuais, em uma experiência fluida. Descubra tudo isso no inédito Modo Aventura, uma jornada alegre e guiada por uma história na qual você dança ao longo das décadas. Disney/Pixar Toy Story 3 Complete Edition Reabra o baú de brinquedos e prepare-se para a aventura na pele de Woody, Buzz Lightyear e Jessie em Toy Story 3 Complete Edition , uma aventura em 3D baseada no sucesso de animação de 2010, Toy Story 3 . A versão atualizada do jogo conta com gráficos aprimorados e algumas novas surpresas. Reviva momentos fiéis ao filme no Modo História ou mergulhe no mundo aberto do Velho Oeste de Woody’s Roundup no Modo Caixa de Brinquedos. Volte ao quarto de Andy ao lado de Woody, Buzz Lightyear e outros personagens clássicos em Toy Story: Retro Roundup! Esta coleção de cinco jogos inclui versões para consoles e portáteis de quatro dos primeiros títulos de Toy Story , além de Vida de Inseto . Todos os jogos foram aprimorados com novos recursos, melhorias de qualidade de vida e um baú de brinquedos

sources.text: Gears of War E-Day é bom? Confira review com o novo exclusivo do Xbox e PC O Xbox Game Pass é um dos serviços de assinatura de games mais democráticos da atualidade, já que é possível acessá-lo de diferentes plataformas — incluindo os próprios, consoles da Microsoft, assim como no PC, nuvem, celulares, tablets e até Smart TVs Samsung e LG com modelos de 2022 para cá. Felizmente, seu catálogo também é atualizado quase que semanalmente, trazendo inúmeras opções para os assinantes aproveitarem — e o melhor de tudo: gastando pouco em comparação às novas tendências de preços da indústria. Se veio em busca de novos jogos para jogar através do Xbox Game Pass , está no lugar certo. O serviço ganhou um reforço de peso esta semana com a chegada de quatro títulos para os assinantes aproveitarem. Confira abaixo mais informações sobre as novas aventuras! Gears of War: E-Day é uma prequel do primeiro jogo da franquia e acompanha Marcus Fenix e Dominic Santiago durante o Dia da Emergência, 14 anos antes dos acontecimentos originais. A campanha mostra o surgimento da Horda Locust e o início da batalha pela sobrevivência da humanidade. O game aposta na ação brutal característica da série, com uma história focada na origem dos personagens e do conflito contra os Locust. Gears of War: E-Day chegou no primeiro dia ao Xbox Game Pass. Echo Weaver é um metroidvania com foco em exploração, conhecimento e manipulação do tempo. No papel do último Tecelão, o jogador precisa aprender com cada ciclo temporal e utilizar as anomalias para encontrar uma forma de quebrar a repetição. A aventura combina exploração e resolução de mistérios, fazendo com que as informações obtidas durante as tentativas sejam parte essencial da progressão. O jogo também chegou no primeiro dia ao Xbox Game Pass. Forever Ago acompanha Alfred, que parte em uma viagem pelo norte após uma tragédia que muda sua vida. A aventura solo é centrada na exploração de diferentes lugares, no encontro com novos personagens e na busca por redenção. Durante a jornada, o jogador poderá registrar momentos com uma câmera, conhecer pessoas e construir novas amizades. Claro, Forever Ago também chegou ao Xbox Game Pass no primeiro dia. Por fim, Neon Abyss 2 combina plataforma e ação roguelike em um cenário cyberpunk repleto de elementos pixelados. Na pele de um personagem lançado em Nova Atenas, o jogador precisa enfrentar o Abismo e diferentes ameaças enquanto busca vingança. A experiência é construída em torno de tentativas sucessivas, com a morte fazendo parte da progressão. Cada derrota permite uma nova oportunidade de explorar o Abismo e avançar em meio aos desafios. sources.name: Xbox Wire
sources.title: DMZ — 5 Features to Get Excited for in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4’s New Mode
sources.text: Call of Duty’s upcoming DMZ mode sounds like it’s shaping up to be something special. Set on the new Hajin map and inspired by the events and locations from Modern Warfare 4 ’s Campaign, this open-world combat environment will challenge you to loot, complete objectives, fight both enemies and rival Operators, and extract before everything you’ve earned is lost. Recent intel drops on the official Call of Duty Blog have given us a much clearer picture of what awaits in Hajin when DMZ launches as part of Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 . Players who have digitally pre-ordered or pre-purchased Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 can gain Early Access to the game’s Campaign starting Friday, October 16 and all of DMZ starting Tuesday, October 20. The events within DMZ are set after the main MW4 Campaign, leaving a power vacuum in its wake. Now it’s up to you to identify a new, mysterious threat and dismantle its operations across the DMZ through various deployments. From scavenging for crafting materials and experimenting with new technology, to leveling up an Operator, the mode sounds like it offers plenty to look forward to. Here are five features to get excited for when you begin your deployment. The 3D Printer will be available back at the Forward Operating Base (FOB) between deployments and will serve as your primary crafting station to build equipment and upgrades for your loadout before you drop into Hajin. The Call of Duty Blog shares that , as you progress through the DMZ, you’ll unlock new crafting recipes to create more powerful equipment – as well as upgrades to the 3D Printer and even the Forward Operating Base itself. Recipes can also be found on deployments and, presuming you extract in one piece, you can then craft those items for your Operator back at the FOB. When focused on crafting new equipment, the two key things you’ll be looking for when looting on deployments will be Resources and 3D Printer Ingredients – these are the two types of main elements to craft all items. There are four basic Resources to find during a deployment: Synthetics, Electronics, Chemicals, and Metals, automatically broken down from looted items, into your Backpack and Stash. 3D Printer Ingredients are rarer materials found in specific areas of Hajin and are valuable as an ingredient to make a new Item. Examples include Binding Catalyst, Biomaterials, Detonators, and Control Units, to name a few. Once you have enough of these two types of materials, you can select how many copies of an item you want to craft at once, then choose where crafted items go: send completed items directly to your Stash for later or equip them directly to your Operator to quickly prepare for the next deployment. Having this flexibility in how you want to engage the enemy during your deployment can open a variety of experiences in DMZ and can make each deployment feel like it matters, even if you come back to the FOB with zero kills to your name – at least you’ve got handful of electronics or a comms module to make it worth your time. Extraction shooters are always more engaging when every deployment has a clear purpose. That’s not going to be problem with DMZ as it will offer three ways to deploy: Story Missions, Dynamic Operations, and Free Roam. Of those, Story Missions and Dynamic Operations are two that really stand out with their defined objectives and high-tier rewards. According to the Call of Duty Blog , Story Missions will feature narrative-led deployments that you can complete and replay, though some remain locked until prerequisites are met. Each entry provides briefing intel, required objectives, and rewards – usually high-value gear and DMZ Cash – along with options for a random mission and additional milestone rewards. Dynamic Operations, meanwhile, give squads multiple goals to pursue within the DMZ. After deploying, you choose an operation and complete its objectives to earn DMZ XP, Cash, and the ability to call in a Supply Drop filled with unpredictable loot. That extra payoff adds anticipation to every successful Op while making Dynamic Operations a promising source of both Cash and XP. Persistent Operators may be DMZ’s most exciting feature because they allow Hajin to leave a lasting mark on you. You’ll begin with two Operator slots, and unlock a third as you progress through DMZ levels. Each Operator then grows stronger by surviving deployments and earning DMZ XP. Each successful exfil levels up your Operator’s Dog Tags, and this is the key to gaining Trait Points for your Operator. You can invest those points across the Warfighter, Scout, and Survivalist Trait Trees, creating a meaningful choice between specialization and flexibility: with a maximum of 18 points to earn, and a choice of over 60 Trait Points to augment your Operator, you can tailor each Operator to your skills and preferred role. For example, Warfighter Traits include Combat Resistance, Quick Fix, and Viper Sense; Scout Traits include improved Thermal Padding, UAV Upgrade, and Field Crafting; while Survivalist Traits include Faster and Free Revives, increased Consumable Duration, and many more. But here’s where it gets dicey: if an Operator fails to extract and becomes MIA, you must either recover them with DMZ Cash or dismiss them. Because recovery costs rise with Trait investment, bringing back a high-level Operator becomes increasingly expensive. Recovered Operators keep their Traits but lose their gear, putting real weight behind every deployment. The chase for loot is at the heart of every extraction shooter, and DMZ makes each haul matter beyond the current deployment. Returning to base with a pack full of supplies doesn’t just feel rewarding – it improves your chances of success the next time you enter Hajin. Once you drop into a deployment, looting should be a top priority. Searching containers provides resources for combat, supports marked Operations, strengthens your position in Hajin, and offers a reliable way to earn DMZ XP and adva

sources.title: DMZ for Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 being released early, but Infinity Ward shoots down PvE hopes
sources.text: In yet another surprising move for Call of Duty, Modern Warfare 4 studio Infinity Ward has announced that the game's extraction shooter mode, DMZ, will be released prior to the game's official launch. DMZ will be available starting 20th October for players who pre-order a copy digitally. Modern Warfare 4 now effectively has three release dates. The campaign unlocks 16th October , DMZ four days later on the 20th, and the full launch - which is when multiplayer will be playable - arrives 23rd October. Though Infinity Ward has offered campaign early access with other Modern Warfare titles in the past, doing the same for DMZ - a multiplayer mode - is certainly new. It's a potentially shrewd move, allowing DMZ to capture streamers and generate excitement about the game ahead of its release over an entire week, with a big blip every few days. It also allows players curious about DMZ to play it without feeling they ought to be making progress in multiplayer instead. Seeing as DMZ has its own separate progression , however, players who jump in early could potentially have an advantage come launch if they manage to accrue many items, not to mention the map knowledge they would get from simply spending more time playing. Separately, Infinity Ward hosted a Reddit Q&A focusing on DMZ , and the question of a PvE-only playlist came up. If you're unfamiliar, a recent first-look gameplay video showed an option for Single Squad Mission in DMZ, which players took to mean a mode free from other players. However, the option disappeared in a follow-up trailer, leading to confusion. So what's going on there? Infinity Ward has an explanation, albeit an unconvincing one. "The playlist you saw is a developer playlist that was never intended to be for public use, it lets our team load into a match alone to work," the developer answered . "In the shipping game, players choose to be solo by turning off squad fill, but it's not guaranteed to be only solos in that lobby." I'm not convinced. Though it's obviously possible for Single Squad to be a dev-only mode, they typically don't require bespoke icons. It's also curious that Infinity Ward didn't blur the image to cover that bit of it, which is commonly done in these sorts of behind-the-scenes videos of gameplay footage, whenever the camera captures something we're not supposed to see. Modern Warfare 4 officially launches 23rd October on PC, PS5, Xbox Series X/S and Switch 2 .

sources.title: BlazBlue: Central Fiction coming to PS5
sources.text: Arc System Works will release a PlayStation 5 version of 2015-released fighting game BlazBlue: Central Fiction , the developer announced . The company recently announced that it will release new downloadable content character Trinity Glassfille for the PlayStation 4 and PC versions of the game. The PlayStation 5 version will feature rollback netcode, cross-play with the PC version, four new text languages, and new Training Mode features. Trinity Glassfille’s release will differ from the PlayStation 5 version and language update’s release. BlazBlue: Central Fiction has been released across PlayStation 4, PlayStation 3, Switch, PC via Steam , and arcades.

stories.summary: Star Citizen developer Cloud Imperium Games has pulled back the curtain on single-player spinoff Squadron 42 with a new cinematic trailer, the launch of Steam wishlists, and a full cast reveal.

sources.name: IGN
sources.title: Star Citizen Single-Player Spinoff Squadron 42 Reemerges With Flashy New Trailer, Steam Wishlists, and Cast Confirmation
sources.text: Star Citizen developer Cloud Imperium Games has pulled back the curtain on single-player spinoff Squadron 42 with a new cinematic trailer, the launch of Steam wishlists, and a full cast reveal. Squadron 42 is the story-driven off-shoot of space sim Star Citizen, which Cloud Imperium Games has worked on for the last 12 years. Its 12-year development is led by Chris Roberts, creator of the Wing Commander series. Indeed, Squadron 42 is a spiritual successor to Wing Commander, and like the Wing Commander games, Squadron 42 features a string of Hollywood stars, such as Mark Hamill, Gary Oldman, Gillian Anderson, Ben Mendelsohn, and Henry Cavill. The game fuses space combat, first-person shooter action, and a character-driven narrative supported by full performance capture. CIG said the performances are woven directly into gameplay, so you won’t just see those famous actors within cinematics. And here’s what to expect from the structure of the game: The trailer shows a decent amount of gameplay, including first-person sections, some of which involve platforming and puzzle solving, ship customization, off duty activities, a hacking mini-game, and a glimpse at narrative choices. Ian Duncan, best known for playing Todd Todmore on BBC comedy Broken News, is the male player character, and prolific video game actor Alix Wilton Regan (Samantha Traynor in Mass Effect 3, the female Inquisitor in Dragon Age: Inquisition, Aya in Assassin's Creed Origins, and Lara Croft in the upcoming Tomb Raider games) plays the female player character. In August, CIG delayed Squadron 42 to Q2 2027 , with Roberts insisting it wouldn’t get the attention it deserves if it came out at the end of 2026 because of November’s GTA 6. "At CitizenCon 2024, we announced we would ship in 2026. Our plan was to release in Q4 around IAE," Roberts said at the time. "But much like the rest of the industry there is no way I want to launch my spiritual successor to Wing Commander, a game that has had 12 years of blood, sweat and tears invested into it (we started Squadron 42 development in 2014 as 2013 was opening studios, hiring people and getting the Hangar module out for Star Citizen) launching into the attention buzz saw of GTA 6. While GTA 6 isn’t launching on PC this November, pretty much all outlets and most content creators will be all over it, not leaving a lot of room for other coverage." The delay announcement came hot on the heels of a disastrous Star Citizen developer livestream that went radically off the rails . After early access players complained of bugs and issues with a new update to the game, CIG held a stream to show the "intended" version of the experience, only to be met with the same issues, if not worse. It led to passive-aggressive comments between the developers themselves and an uncomfortable tension in the air. Star Citizen crossed the $1 billion raised barrier in May — a significant milestone that came shortly after a $5,000 virtual spaceship you couldn’t actually fly in-game went on sale. It’s since raised a further $50 million. Star Citizen is considered one of the most controversial projects in all video games. Over the 14 years since its crowdfunding drive began, Star Citizen has been called many things, including a scam by those who wonder whether it will ever properly launch. Its virtual ships, some of which cost thousands of dollars, are often the focus of criticism. But its loyal fanbase insist it's one of the most compelling space sims around, and continue to pump millions of dollars into the project via ship sales. Star Citizen itself remains without a release window. Wesley is IGN's Managing Editor. Find him on Twitter at @wyp100. You can reach Wesley at wesley_yinpoole@ign.com or confidentially at wyp100@proton.me.

sources.title: Squadron 42 has a Steam page
sources.text: Star Citizen's singleplayer mode gets a new trailer and more signs of life. In August, game director Chris Roberts said that Star Citizen's singleplayer component, Squadron 42, was being delayed out of 2026 to avoid clashing with Grand Theft Auto 6 . There was a certain amount of skepticism about the reason for the delay, thanks in part to a recent Star Citizen livestream being declared a disaster , but also because, well. These games have had so many release dates the changes have their own wiki page . There's something concrete about having Squadron 42 getting a Steam page though, with system requirements and everything. Those system requirements are charmingly old-fashioned, with no mention of ray tracing-capable GPUs or DirectX 12. Although the install size of 150GB is still pretty hefty. ( Final Fantasy 7 Revelation is apparently going to be 200GB , oof.) There's also a new trailer, which leans heavily on the oorah stuff that's always a bit of a turn-off in military science-fiction. Privateer was my favorite Wing Commander game because it left out all the Top Gun nonsense, but of course it's front-and-center in Squadron 42. So too are the celebrity actors, with appearances by Mark Hamill, Gary Oldman, Rhona Mitra, that guy who played the Onion Knight in Game of Thrones, and other people who probably filmed most of their scenes a solid decade ago now. We also get to see a fair bit of the male version of the player-character, who will doubtless BroShep his way into most of the promos even though I'll be picking the one voiced by Alix Wilton Regan instead. The Steam page lists Squadron 42's release date as Q2 2027, and I'd love to see it actually release on that date and be the solid combo of Wing Commander and Half-Life 2 that happens to have Gillian Anderson and Henry Cavill in the cutscenes that's being promised here. It could happen. stories.title: Developer Goes Into Debt Spending $1,000 A Day To Keep Steam Demo For AI-Fueled Driving Sim Going
stories.summary: Hoping to launch next year, Teach My Little Sister How To Drive is prematurely sending its creators into the red over exhaustive token use

sources.name: Kotaku
sources.title: Developer Goes Into Debt Spending $1,000 A Day To Keep Steam Demo For AI-Fueled Driving Sim Going
sources.text: Teach My Little Sister How To Drive is an upcoming DMV simulator where players, riding passenger, instruct a chaotic young student to pass their exam. Developers Easy Fox are embracing AI for the project, the titular sister a live chat bot that the player is instructing. Beyond contention for the tech, Easy Fox are finding that the mere demo for the game is proving to be problematic, as accounting for the token usage is forcing them into debt . “Over the past month, the number of demo players has grown more than twentyfold,” reads the Steam pageâs latest update . “Thank you so much for giving our game far more attention than we ever expected. This growth has also increased our operating costs considerably.” As the update explains, the game originally patched players through to a chat bot operating on Googleâs Gemini. With no cost barrier between them and the curious, players of the demo were triggering limit-use errors, Google informing Easy Fox that thereâs no easy way out. Switching to the competing OpenAI model, while hoping to finding a fix with Gemini, is proving to be the least of their problems. Easy Fox says the surge of players has forced them to take out a bank loan to keep the demo operating. Maintaining the demo is apparently costing them more than $1,000 a day, which they admit they will have to factor into pricing the final product. While a number of game developers have flocked to AI to create in-game assets and code on the back-end, Teach My Little Sister is a more unique case. Leveraging an agent for sustained real-time gameplay, the game has found an expensive way to recreate what Lifeline and Hey You, Pikachu! accomplished over 20 years ago. “We want to continue operating the demo and would love for more people to enjoy it,” writes Easy Fox. “However, we are a small team of four, and financial pressure may mean we have to close the demo earlier than expected before the full release. We have not made that decision at this time.” The update also addresses complaints that, even in a game based around calamity, the AI fueled sister is not following instructions as desired. While a microcosm of it, the financial strain is an amusing illustration of one of AIâs biggest white elephant. That is, no oneâs sure how to make money off of it. While proliferating in short video content, horrifying fast food posters and visual assets devs “meant to take out,” the firms themselves are running purely on investments, not generating profit. The amount of resources needed to keep these computers burning continually outweighs what the public is otherwise willing to spend to see SpongeBob murder Shrek . Over the last year, AI firms have been forced to adjust, adding new premiums to their service, the so-called “tokenpocalypse.” With the global economy now held hostage by the industry, the burdens of the tech continue to put people on edge. Easy Fox are being taught a swift lesson on something the global population is likely going to learn the hard way. Donât miss the latest reviews, news and tips. Sign up for our free newsletter. sources.title: The developer of an AI-powered driving instruction simulator is spending $1,000 per month just to keep its demo running
sources.text: Teach My Little Sister How to Drive centres around a costly chatbot. One of the many ways AI will (supposedly) revolutionise the games industry in facilitating highly reactive NPCs via LLM-powered chatbots. Yet so far, only a handful of games like Where Winds Meet have attempted to implement the tech, and the results have been less than spectacular. But there might also be another reason why relatively few games feature LLM-powered NPCs, which is that powering such chatbots can be costly, as recently demonstrated by the developers of an upcoming driving instructor simulator As reported by FRVR (via Kotaku ) Teach My Little Sister How To Drive is a comic simulation game in which you coach your virtual sibling on driving technique from the comfort of the passenger seat. The twist is that behind your sister's dinner-plate eyes is an LLM chatbot (currently powered by an OpenAI model, though the developers intend to use Gemini for the final release) In the role of instructor, players can both converse with the chatbot and issue vocal instructions such as "turn left here", to which the bot will respond accordingly. At least, that's the theory. Developer Easy Fox released a demo for Teach My Little Sister How To Drive back in February, but in the past month the game has seen a surge in players, which has had an interesting knock-on effect for the demo. "The number of demo players has grown more than twentyfold," Easy Fox explained in a Steam post , adding. "This growth has also increased our operating costs considerably." Easy Fox goes on to explain that it is "spending over $1,000 per day on AI services for the demo", as players burn through tokens prompting the LLM by proxy. Easy Fox claims that figure "isn't because each player is particularly expensive to support", but rather that "so many people are playing." As a result of this, Easy Fox has "taken out a bank loan to help keep the demo running". Yet even this may not be sufficient to support the demo long term. "Financial pressure may mean we have to close the demo earlier than expected before the full release," Easy Fox says, though the studio stresses it has "not made that decision at this time". According to FRVR, that twentyfold increase in players amounts to 450 concurrent. While the overall player numbers will be higher than that, it isn't an enormous figure, and it makes me wonder how financially viable the game will be when it is released. Easy Fox says it will "account for expected AI usage in the game's price". But it also says that players "will not be charged separately for their individual AI token usage after purchasing the game". That might work in the short term, but surely those token costs are going to pile up over time. It's also worth noting that AI token costs are highly unpredictable , with even large companies like Microsoft and Uber struggling to accurately predict the cost and burn rate of their own internal token use. In its Steam post, Easy Fox says it's looking into options like introducing local AI models for players with "sufficiently capable GPUs". But that's only going to be a fraction of the player-base. Keep up to date with the most important stories and the best deals, as picked by the PC Gamer team. All of this is aside from whether an AI-powered driving instruction game is a good idea. Personally, I think the fact that it revolves specifically around chatting with another character makes this a more sensible application than in Where Winds Meet, where the chatbots don't factor into the game design in any meaningful way. It's much more reminiscent of early chatbot-based social sim Façade . But the very fact it reminds me of Façade makes me wonder whether the game needs a premium LLM connected to it to achieve its goal. Easy Fox states that current design problems being addressed include "dialogue that feels too artificial and breaks immersion" and "commands being carried out incorrectly, such as turning right when asked to turn left." All of which seems like it could be solved with a good voice actor and a sufficiently rich dialogue system. Easy Fox plans to release the full game in January next year, so we'll find out exactly how the finances stack up then. 2026 games : All the upcoming games Best PC games : Our all-time favorites Free PC games : Freebie fest Best FPS games : Finest gunplay Best RPGs : Grand adventures Best co-op games : Better together Rick has been fascinated by PC gaming since he was seven years old, when he used to sneak into his dad's home office for covert sessions of Doom. He grew up on a diet of similarly unsuitable games, with favourites including Quake, Thief, Half-Life and Deus Ex. Between 2013 and 2022, Rick was games editor of Custom PC magazine and associated website bit-tech.net . But he's always kept one foot in freelance games journalism, writing for publications like Edge, Eurogamer, the Guardian and, naturally, PC Gamer. While he'll play anything that can be controlled with a keyboard and mouse, he has a particular passion for first-person shooters and immersive sims. stories.title: Entenda os 5 diferentes finais de Silent Hill: Townfall
stories.summary: O final de Townfall é determinado por algumas ações ao longo do jogo

sources.name: Voxel
sources.title: Entenda os 5 diferentes finais de Silent Hill: Townfall
sources.text: Silent Hill: Townfall , o novo spin-off desenvolvido pela Screen Burnem parceria com a Konami, chega para expandir o universo da franquia em um cenário inédito . Desta vez, estamos na isolada ilha escocesa de St. Amelia, em 1996. O protagonista, Simon Ordell, é convocado de volta à cidade para “colocar as coisas em ordem”, mas encontra apenas uma névoa densa cobrindo ruas aparentemente abandonadas. Apesar de não se passar na cidade famosa da franquia, o tipo de contexto é basicamente o mesmo. Seguindo a tradição de jogos da série, Townfall não conta com um final único. Em vez disso, as ações do jogador ao longo da campanha determinam qual desfecho a história vai tomar. Para te ajudar a entender melhor o conceito, listamos os todos os finais de Silent Hill: Townfall e te contamos o que é necessário para conseguir cada um deles. Confira! Como revelado previamente pelos desenvolvedores, o jogo conta com 5 finais diferentes, sendo que 2 são secretos. Assim como em jogos anteriores da série, as decisões tomadas pelo jogador ao longo da aventura é que definem o desfecho, até para que o final pareça coerente com a experiência vivida durante a partida. Não existe uma escolha explícita em algum momento marcante do enredo que define isso, já que o final é determinado por alguns elementos diferentes. O sistema acompanha o comportamento do jogador durante toda a partida, incluindo o quanto ele explora e investiga St. Amelia e o quão agressivo ele é ao ser confrontado por inimigos, em contraste com evitar ou fugir dos combates. Essa abordagem lembra diretamente o clássico Silent Hill 2 , em que o final também refletia padrões de comportamento e não escolhas de diálogo, por exemplo. Dos 5 desfechos possíveis , 3 estão disponíveis já na primeira vez que você zera a campanha , sem necessidade de repetir o jogo. Já os outros 2 finais secretos exigem uma segunda campanha jogada no modo New Game Plus. Esses 3 finais “normais” são chamados de Justice, Forever e Abandoned e são considerados os desfechos principais da trama de Simon. Eles são determinados exclusivamente pela relação entre quantos inimigos o jogador elimina durante a partida e quantas descobertas, como pistas e documentos, ele coleta ao longo do caminho. O tempo de jogo ou uso de itens de cura não influencia nesse resultado. Também é bom mencionar que que esse equilíbrio entre mortes e descobertas afeta apenas a cena final antes dos créditos, sem alterar outras cenas ou a progressão da história ao longo da campanha. Até por isso, você é que tem lembrar de como quer abordar o jogo para conseguir o final desejado. Conforme mencionamos, além dos 3 finais principais, o jogo reserva 2 desfechos extras classificados como secretos , chamados de Dog e Sci-fi. Quem é fã veterano da franquia Silent Hill sabe que esses são finais absolutamente clássicos e colocados no jogo apenas como uma brincadeira extra para o jogador se divertir. Por serem uma piada, é necessário zerar o game uma vez para conseguir um final sério e, então, zerá-lo uma segunda vez no New Game Plus para ter acesso aos desfechos secretos. Como explicado acima, o sistema de finais de Townfall não depende de escolhas de diálogo ou momentos de decisão específicos, mas sim do comportamentos do jogador ao longo de toda a campanha. Para facilitar, nós listamos o que é necessário para cada um. O final Justice é considerado por muitos como o desfecho “bom” da história. Ele é obtido ao final de uma campanha em que o número de descobertas, na forma de pistas e documentos coletados, é significativamente maior do que o número de inimigos eliminados. A boa notícia é que é possível ter dezenas de eliminações e ainda assim alcançar esse final, até porque alguns confrontos ao longo da aventura são praticamente inevitáveis. Por isso, só tente ter certeza de que a quantidade de descobertas seja bem superior. O final Forever é tratado como o desfecho “normal” do jogo. Ele surge quando a quantidade de descobertas é apenas ligeiramente maior do que a quantidade de eliminações ao término da campanha. Diferente do Justice, aqui a margem entre pistas coletadas e inimigos mortos é bem mais estreita, exigindo um equilíbrio mais cuidadoso por parte do jogador ao longo da aventura. Já o Abandoned é considerado o final “ruim” da história. Ele ocorre sempre que o número de inimigos eliminados supera o número de descobertas feitas até o fim do jogo. Para quem opta por um estilo de jogo mais agressivo, ignorando documentos e pistas em favor do combate direto, esse desfecho é praticamente garantido. O final “Dog” é um dos desfechos secretos, exclusivos do New Game Plus. Ele é desbloqueado ao encontrar três moedas especiais espalhadas por diferentes áreas da cidade durante a nova campanha. Com as moedas em mãos, você precisa depositá-las em cofres em formato de cachorro, ligados a uma instituição de cães-guia presente no cenário do jogo. Completar essa sequência de itens substitui o final principal que o jogador obteria normalmente. O Sci-fi é o segundo final secreto, também restrito ao New Game Plus. Para obtê-lo, é necessário interagir com três livros específicos escondidos em diferentes pontos da campanha, resolver um quebra-cabeça de porta usando um código, e por fim utilizar um item especial obtido nesse processo em um painel eletrônico próximo ao fim da aventura. Diferente dos demais finais, o Sci-fi é acionado antes da batalha final, pulando completamente esse confronto e levando direto ao desfecho. Se não quiser spoilers sobre os finais de Silent Hill: Townfall, é melhor pular essa parte do nosso guia! No final “Justice”, Simon consegue encarar os traumas do seu passado de frente, encontrando uma resolução pacífica e libertadora para a sua culpa. No final “Forever”, o protagonista se recusa a aceitar os fatos totalmente e decide permanecer preso na névoa e nas memórias da ilha. No final Abandoned, dominado pela raiva e violência, Simon sucumbe totalmente ao pesadelo e se torna parte do ciclo de sofrimento do loc

sources.name: Eurogamer
sources.title: Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls reveals its Year 1 DLC roster, starting with Phoenix Cyclops on 2nd November
sources.text: Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls has revealed its full Year 1 DLC roster, with Phoenix Cyclops, Thor (Jane Foster), Venom, and Jubilee all on the way. Developer Arc System Works announced the lineup on Twitter/X , alongside artwork by Marvel artist Peach Momoko. Phoenix Cyclops is first, arriving on 2nd November, with Classic and Legacy costumes for the character launching the same day. Thor (Jane Foster) follows in winter 2027, then Venom and a Klyntar stage in spring 2027. Jubilee is expected to drop in summer 2027. The Year 1 full roster has been revealed! Who is joining your team? 🐦‍🔥 Phoenix Cyclops coming on November 2! 🔨 Thor (Jane Foster) - Winter 2027 🫟 Venom - Spring 2027 🛼 Jubilee - Summer 2027 We've teamed up with @peachmomoko60 to tease our upcoming characters through her… pic.twitter.com/oX0rtugASh The characters and the stage make up the Year One Characters & Stage Pass, although each can also be bought individually. In a PlayStation Blog post , producer Takeshi Yamanaka explained why the team picked the Phoenix version of Cyclops, with new visuals, Optic Blasts, and Dark Phoenix gameplay. "During those discussions, our narrative team proposed the idea of using the Phoenix version of Cyclops," Yamanaka said. "We felt this interpretation would allow us to create fresher visuals and a more exciting fighting style while offering something unexpected for players." It's also why he's DLC and not a day-one fighter. Yamanaka said the team "made the difficult decision to continue working on the character until we felt like we were adding something new", before releasing him as its first post-launch character. Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls is out now on PS5 and PC.

sources.name: Video Games Chronicle
sources.title: Marvel Tokon’s Year One DLC roster confirmed, including Venom, Thor and Jubilee
sources.text: Four characters and one stage will be available individually or as part of a season pass The full Year One DLC line-up for Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls has been confirmed. As revealed during the EVO France fighting game competition this past weekend, a total of four characters will be coming to the game over the course of the next year, as well as one stage. The first to be added is Phoenix Cyclops, who was previously announced last week. He’ll be added to the game on November 2, it’s been confirmed. He’ll be followed by Thor (the Jane Foster version), who will arrive in ‘Winter 2027’. Because of the order the characters are listed, this likely means early 2027, rather than late in the year. Spring 2027 will see the arrival of Venom, as well as a new stage set on the planet Klyntar, the living prison created by symbiotes. Finally, rounding off the Year 1 DLC is X-Men teenager Jubilee, who will arrive in Summer 2027. All four characters and the Klyntar stage will be available to purchase individually, but a Year One pass will also be offered for those who wish to buy them all at a reduced price. Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls was released in August and was critically well received, with a current Metacritic score of 85. The game had problematic launch on Steam , however, with players reporting stuttering and inconsistent frame rates â something more forgivable in an action adventure game or an RPG, but not in a fighting game where expert players may study certain techniques on a frame-by-frame basis. Producer Takeshi Yamanaka told VGC in August that while he was “very appreciative” to see “a positive reception” to the game’s content itself, and among console players, the team was also well aware of the issues faced by PC players. “Currently, the team is hard at work on fixing these issues, and weâve now released two urgent patches,” he said at the time. “The CPU processing load issue has been greatly improved now as of the latest patch. However, the team is still hard at work to continue working on resolving remaining issues.”

especial_gta6.tema: Jason Duval: quem é o protagonista de GTA 6
especial_gta6.angulo: Quem é o homem que divide o protagonismo de GTA 6 com Lucia: ex-militar, faz-tudo de traficantes nas Keys e alguém que só quer uma vida fácil, a pouco mais de um mês do lançamento.

fatos.texto: Jason Duval é um dos dois protagonistas de GTA 6, ao lado de Lucia Caminos.
Segundo o perfil oficial, Jason cresceu cercado de golpistas e criminosos.
Ele entrou para o Exército numa tentativa de deixar para trás uma juventude problemática.
Depois do Exército, Jason foi parar nas Keys, a região de ilhas de Leonida (a versão da Flórida no jogo), trabalhando para traficantes locais, e está pensando em tentar algo novo.
O lema do personagem no site oficial: Jason quer uma vida fácil, mas as coisas só ficam mais difíceis.
Para a Rockstar, conhecer Lucia pode ser a melhor ou a pior coisa que já aconteceu na vida de Jason.
Jason mora sem pagar aluguel num imóvel de Brian Heder, um veterano do tráfico; em troca, ajuda Brian com achaques locais.
Duas falas de Jason aparecem no site oficial: "Se acontecer alguma coisa, estou bem atrás de você" e "Mais um dia no paraíso, né?".

Na sinopse oficial, Jason e Lucia sempre souberam que as cartas estavam marcadas contra eles; quando um golpe fácil dá errado, os dois caem no lado mais sombrio de Vice City, no meio de uma conspiração criminosa que se espalha pelo estado de Leonida, e precisam confiar um no outro para sair vivos.
A Rockstar publicou os perfis oficiais dos personagens no site de GTA VI em 6 de maio de 2025, no mesmo dia em que lançou o Trailer 2.

O vídeo 'Grand Theft Auto VI: An Extended Look', com cerca de 26 minutos de jogo capturado no PS5, estreou na Netflix em 27 de agosto de 2026 às 15h (horário de Nova York, 16h em Brasília) e chegou ao YouTube da Rockstar às 21h (22h em Brasília) do mesmo dia.
No Extended Look, a primeira missão mostra Jason e Lucia indo buscar uma carga para Boobie Ike; a polícia aparece e os dois fogem atirando.
O vídeo mostra Jason roubando um carro com um minijogo para arrombar a janela.
No Extended Look, Jason encontra um cachorro e pode interagir com ele, por exemplo fazendo carinho.
No fim do Extended Look, Jason e Lucia trabalham como seguranças na inauguração de uma sede corporativa, e o evento é atacado por criminosos armados.
Rumor, sem confirmação da Rockstar: fãs apontam o ator Dylan Rourke como intérprete de Jason; SVG, Pure Xbox e PCGamesN registram a teoria e destacam que o elenco não foi anunciado.

GTA 6 sai em 19 de novembro de 2026 para PS5 e Xbox Series X|S, segundo o site oficial e a GameSpot (agosto de 2026); em maio de 2025 a Rockstar havia anunciado 26 de maio de 2026, data que depois foi adiada.
